welcome.title: Welcome to Rea
welcome.body: An intimate space to get to know your cycle at your own pace. What you log stays on your phone, only for you.

profile.title: Tell me about you
profile.lead: This is enough to tailor what you'll see. Nothing more.

intent.title: What are you looking for in Rea?
intent.modifierHint: Optional: pick none to just learn your cycle.

cycle.title: Track my cycle
cycle.subtitle: Understand your body and anticipate your days.

pregnancy.title: Track my pregnancy
pregnancy.subtitle: Care for this stage step by step.

track.title: Know my cycle
track.subtitle: Understand my body and anticipate it.

preg.title: I'm pregnant
preg.subtitle: Care for this stage step by step.

lastPeriod.title: Your last period
lastPeriod.lead: When did your last period start? It's the starting point for your predictions.

cycle.title: Your cycle length
cycle.lead: It's a starting point; Rea will refine it with every log.
cycle.help: Not sure? Leave 5 and 28; we'll adjust together.

regularity.title: How regular is your cycle?
regularity.lead: No pressure: pick what looks most like you.

regular.title: Regular
regular.subtitle: Almost always arrives when I expect it.

irregular.title: Irregular
irregular.subtitle: Changes a lot from month to month.

contraception.title: Are you on hormonal contraception?
contraception.lead: Pill, hormonal IUD, implant, injection… It changes how Rea reads your cycle.
contraception.warning: If you are, Rea logs symptoms and bleeding but won't mark fertile days as natural.

pregnancySetup.title: Your pregnancy
pregnancySetup.lead: The date of your last period helps estimate gestational age.
pregnancySetup.dueToggleTitle: I know the estimated due date
pregnancySetup.help: Without this date, Rea estimates via Naegele's rule (LMP + 280 days).

notifications.title: Gentle reminders
notifications.lead: We check in on you, without overwhelming. You decide when.
notifications.enableSubtitle: We'll notify you within the window you choose.

complete.title: Thank you for letting us join you
complete.lead: From here, Rea learns with you.
complete.disclaimer: Rea does not diagnose and is not a contraceptive method. Its estimates are based on what you log.
complete.error: We couldn't complete onboarding. Please try again.

validation.invalidLastPeriodRange: The end date cannot be before the start date.
validation.invalidPregnancyDueDate: The due date must be after your last period.
